title: Robust absorption for typed triangles
abstract: Typed triangle decomposition results from Paper II: a typical-host theorem under three-step links for four-label families; its nearly complete and balanced deductions with explicit type-weight hypotheses; a semidense two-label mixed-triangle theorem; a computer-assisted typical-host theorem for every admissible four-label family; and a terminal absorber obtained from a bounded signed certificate and explicit physical hinge supply. Divisibility includes global edge counts and local degree profiles. The typical-host hypotheses are retained; the result is not asserted for arbitrary divisible hosts. The repository contains the substantive proof development, including the finite family census and conserved-family constructions, with a small independent Mathlib-only Challenge.
